barbie_list.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
barbie_list.description: Barbie stars as Clara in this magical adaptation of the classic ballet about a young girl who embarks on an adventure to save her beloved nutcracker.

barbie_list.title: Barbie as Rapunzel
barbie_list.description: Barbie plays Rapunzel, a young artist who uses a magical paintbrush to break a spell and find her true love.

barbie_list.title: Barbie of Swan Lake
barbie_list.description: Barbie stars as Odette, a young baker who discovers she is destined to break a spell and save a magical forest.

barbie_list.title: Barbie as the Princess and the Pauper
barbie_list.description: Barbie stars as both Princess Anneliese and poor seamstress Erika who swap places and discover that true royalty comes from within.

barbie_list.title: Barbie: Fairytopia
barbie_list.description: Barbie plays Elina, a fairy with no wings who embarks on a journey to save her home from an evil fairy.

barbie_list.title: Barbie and the Magic of Pegasus
barbie_list.description: Barbie plays Princess Annika who rides a winged horse to defeat a wizard and save her kingdom.

barbie_list.title: Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses
barbie_list.description: Barbie stars as Princess Genevieve who, along with her 11 sisters, discovers a magical world that helps them stand up to their strict aunt.

barbie_list.title: Barbie as the Island Princess
barbie_list.description: Barbie plays Ro, a shipwrecked girl raised by animals who discovers her royal heritage and learns to follow her heart.

barbie_list.title: Barbie: Mariposa and Her Butterfly Fairy Friends
barbie_list.description: Barbie plays Mariposa, a bookish fairy who goes on a mission to save her queen and discovers her inner strength.

barbie_list.title: Barbie and the Diamond Castle
barbie_list.description: Barbie and her best friend tell a story of two best friends whose friendship is tested by jealousy but prevails through music and loyalty.

barbie_list.title: Barbie: A Christmas Carol
barbie_list.description: Barbie stars as Eden Starling, a selfish singer in Victorian London who learns the true meaning of Christmas.

barbie_list.title: Barbie: The Princess & The Popstar
barbie_list.description: Barbie stars as both Princess Tori and popstar Keira who magically swap identities and learn that being true to yourself is the key to happiness.
